0.0: So good to see you again! We are in need of your waste management and monster corralling skills once more.
0.1: #o9420508# monsters are have a grand time getting their ink all over the boats and passersby. Could you let them know that sort of behavior is not acceptable in this fine town, an could you also clean up some of that ink?

yes.0: We knew we could rely on you! Defeating 200 of those #b#o9420508##k monsters should show them this isn't the place for their uncouth antics, and collecting #b100 sacks of #t4000373##k should take care of the murky mess.

no.0: Surely you must know how hard it is to wash out ink stains once they set?

1.0: The clean-up is coming along quite well, we see!

yes.0: Our town is looking dazzling again, thanks to you! We'll recommend your services to everyone. Please also take this item as a sign of our appreciation.
